original_PR176_inventory.semantic_caution: 28 records are kernels, solvers, operator examples, selectors and references; not 28 complete production solvers.

rows.mechanism: sequential matrix-free eight-stage original RODAS5P with JVP, protected commit/rollback, and same-error authority
rows.use_when: stiff, oscillatory or nonnormal general ODE when JVP is authorized
rows.non_promotion_limit: reference for all actual speed and accepted-step tests; not new fast-lane claim

rows.mechanism: U-form adaptive RODAS5P with dense factorizations and reduced allocations
rows.use_when: small or moderate stiff systems with full Jacobian permitted
rows.non_promotion_limit: explicit matrix assembly violates primary J-free fast-path target

rows.mechanism: band-aware direct RODAS5P solver
rows.use_when: declared and validated narrow-band stiff system
rows.non_promotion_limit: band structure must be source verified; not universally fast

rows.mechanism: RODAS5P dense continuous extension, optional interior-error control
rows.use_when: dense requested outputs, event location, observed trajectories
rows.non_promotion_limit: enforced interior work differs from endpoint-only work

rows.mechanism: raw U-form matrix-free RODAS5P with GMRES and optional retained GCRO-DR/workspace
rows.use_when: large sparse operator where JVP is cheap and explicit Jacobian impractical
rows.non_promotion_limit: same step equation, stage critical depth still sequential; target-scale cost/performance not admitted

rows.mechanism: exact refreshed-J stage equations with lagged LU factorization as preconditioner
rows.use_when: slowly varying stiff Jacobian and expensive LU where verification supports reuse
rows.non_promotion_limit: lagged factorization may be stale, must admit true residual; explicit J required

rows.mechanism: small dense RODAS5P with static tables and reduced setup
rows.use_when: very small systems with fast dense arithmetic
rows.non_promotion_limit: hardware crossover and identity no unconditional guarantee

rows.mechanism: batch of independent small RODAS5P systems sharing execution organization
rows.use_when: many independent short small stiff IVPs
rows.non_promotion_limit: batch throughput not per-IVP latency; no generic stage parallelization

rows.mechanism: read-only declared structure chooses banded,dense or JVP RODAS backend
rows.use_when: caller supplies trustworthy structure and derivative permissions
rows.non_promotion_limit: static structure routing, not demonstrated dynamic guarded fast-path switching

rows.mechanism: exponential Rosenbrock order-two phi-Krylov action
rows.use_when: semilinear/stiff problem with useful linearized exponential action
rows.non_promotion_limit: no standalone full-order-five adaptive solver admission from step API

rows.mechanism: embedded higher-order exponential Rosenbrock step and fused phi actions
rows.use_when: intermediate candidate/consistency witness for higher-order exponential schemes
rows.non_promotion_limit: step kernel and local order do not establish full IVP runtime

rows.mechanism: fused phi-Krylov adaptive exponential Rosenbrock, resumable bounded prefix; external LLM irrelevant
rows.use_when: stiff, oscillatory, smooth semilinear cases where JVP is permitted and phi actions cheap
rows.non_promotion_limit: frozen v2.2 selected-case order~4.93 and scoped wall ratio~1.52 cannot be promoted to generic production without matched-accuracy broad holdout and switching economy

rows.mechanism: causal q1 prediction + q2 endpoint correction, exact residual admission, charged failure and protected fallback
rows.use_when: fast low-depth stage correction when target defect improves before original fallback
rows.non_promotion_limit: cannot claim reduced critical path until complete whole-trajectory matched-error work/span

rows.mechanism: partial-coupling homotopy stage solve and adaptive original-target residual checking
rows.use_when: difficult nonlinear/stiff stage roots with residual monotonicity and bounded continuation
rows.non_promotion_limit: stage proof/partial root is not generic full-IVP fifth-order and value-only pathway

rows.mechanism: exact/nonlinear RHS-only homotopy root proposal and outward residual for frozen models
rows.use_when: derivative-free first candidate for cubic/regular source-locked stages
rows.non_promotion_limit: full 8-stage generic integration and source epoch binding must be proven; historical C9 flagged owner substitution

rows.mechanism: nonlinear inverse-Picard backward Euler with outward arithmetic and exact local source
rows.use_when: cooperative cubic stiff ODE, Jacobian and Newton forbidden
rows.non_promotion_limit: first order, source-specific; not a drop-in order-five general replacement

rows.mechanism: persistent RHS-only Dormand-Prince 5(4), FSAL and dense output for nonstiff IVPs
rows.use_when: nonstiff or unknown identity-mass ODE with budgeted failure
rows.non_promotion_limit: may stall on strong stiffness; only explicit-first default, not stiff solver fast-path proof

rows.mechanism: RHS-only Lawson DOPRI5 with declared damped rotation semigroup/exact quotient actions
rows.use_when: constant declared 2x2 damped-rotational linear structure and smooth residual
rows.non_promotion_limit: not generic semigroup oracle; no stiffness-uniform nonlinear order

rows.mechanism: fixed/adaptive BDF1 and variable-step BDF2, dense Newton reference
rows.use_when: stiff correctness and step-economy reference/negative controls
rows.non_promotion_limit: explicit frozen reference-only comparator fidelity; not production-equivalent CVODE/BDF baseline

rows.mechanism: implicit one-/three-stage Radau IIA with dense Newton reference
rows.use_when: stiff accuracy and stage/residual oracle
rows.non_promotion_limit: internal reference implementation only; not competitive benchmark for production Radau5

rows.mechanism: SABR5P original stage predictor and block correctness fallback
rows.use_when: stage-root and structured correctness oracle under defined block assumptions
rows.non_promotion_limit: no independent complete adaptive full-IVP production route in current library export

rows.mechanism: continuous-residual whole-tube outward verification wrapped around source-owner candidates
rows.use_when: model owner provides immutable residual/tube capabilities and bounds
rows.non_promotion_limit: cannot be claimed arbitrary callback certified solver; large-scale run and total proof obligations remain

rows.mechanism: independent nonlinear-window shooting with complex prefix, outward endpoint certificate
rows.use_when: declared collective cubic or special flow, not arbitrary ODE
rows.non_promotion_limit: source-bound nonlinear proof and full cost not generic convergence theorem

rows.mechanism: outward reconstructed packet trajectory with physical budget
rows.use_when: specific supplied packet/oscillatory system with source-owned certification
rows.non_promotion_limit: not a generic Rosenbrock alternative

rows.mechanism: bounded explicit DOPRI5 / protected RODAS5P switching at accepted windows with cost evidence
rows.use_when: changing stiffness only when derivative permission, comparability and model epoch are valid
rows.non_promotion_limit: frozen history shows adverse reentrant overhead and no general speedup; default remains RHS-only

rows.mechanism: declared method fitness and derivative-permission selection
rows.use_when: known nonstiff/stiff regimes with user permissions
rows.non_promotion_limit: not uncharged automatic learning or proof of optimal switching

rows.mechanism: Leja, signed Laguerre, Chebyshev, Taylor and low-rank resolvent guarded phi-action alternatives
rows.use_when: operator/domain/enclosure available and cost favors polynomial over Krylov
rows.non_promotion_limit: matrix action or stage backend alone is NOT a complete integrator or verified fifth-order trajectory

rows.mechanism: stage batching and causal/prefix span experiments with all attempted work
rows.use_when: independent or provably causally grouped stages, expensive RHS
rows.non_promotion_limit: parallel stage timing cannot replace full solver same-error benchmark
